Exercise: Plyo Kettlebell Pushups

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
expert

Movement Patterns:

- push

Primary Muscles:

- chest

Secondary Muscles:

- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- power_and_explosiveness

Contraindications:

- Shoulder injuries
- Recent wrist or elbow surgeries

Exercise Variations:

- name: Plyo Kettlebell Pushups with Medicine Ball, equipment: medicine ball

Substitution Options:

- name: Plyo Pushups, equipment: none

Instructions:

- Place a kettlebell on the floor. Place yourself in a pushup position, on your toes with one hand on the ground and one hand holding the kettlebell, with your elbows extended. This will be your starting position.
- Begin by lowering yourself as low as you can, keeping your back straight.
- Quickly and forcefully reverse direction, pushing yourself up to the other side of the kettlebell, switching hands as you do so. Continue the movement by descending and repeating the movement back and forth.
